spec.title: SSHadowForge / NATS JetStream
spec.description: The event bus: the NATS server, JetStream storage, each stream and every durable consumer on it -- SSHadowForge's four (projector, notifier, dispatcher, workflow) and artifact-governance's. Series from prometheus-nats-exporter behind each server's mTLS metrics door.

spec.title: Healthz
spec.description: NATS /healthz answered ok (1) on every server, as the exporter read it.

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Since the server last started. A restart replaces the allocation; JetStream state survives on its sticky host volume.

spec.title: Connections
spec.description: Client connections: the forge's services, daprd sidecars, governance, the gateway hop.

spec.title: Slow consumers (1h)
spec.description: Clients NATS disconnected for not reading fast enough.

spec.title: JetStream storage
spec.description: File storage used against max_file_store (NatsJetStreamStorageHigh at 80%).

spec.title: API errors (1h)
spec.description: JetStream API calls that errored (create/lookup consumer, publish acks).

spec.title: Stuck durables
spec.description: Durables with an unacknowledged message and no ack progress for 10m. Empty is healthy.

spec.expr: (max by (stream_name, consumer_name) (jetstream_consumer_num_ack_pending{stream_name=~"$stream",consumer_name=~"$consumer"}) > 0) and on (stream_name, consumer_name) (max by (stream_name, consumer_name) (changes(jetstream_consumer_ack_floor_stream_seq{stream_name=~"$stream",consumer_name=~"$consumer"}[10m])) == 0)

spec.title: Pending by durable
spec.description: Messages each durable has yet to receive. 0 is caught up.

spec.title: Ack pending
spec.description: Delivered and unacknowledged. The SSHadowForge durables run MaxAckPending 1.

spec.title: Redelivered
spec.description: Messages currently redelivered (nak, retry or AckWait expiry). A durable retrying one message for ever shows here before it shows as stuck.

spec.title: Messages by stream
spec.description: SF_WORK_LOG keeps 90 days (limits); SF_INTEL is a work queue; SF_GOVERNANCE has no max age.

spec.title: Publish rate by stream
spec.description: The stream's last sequence advancing: messages stored per second.

spec.title: Allocation memory by task
spec.description: nats, the exporter and its metrics door (Nomad allocation metrics).

spec.title: Server -- every tile should be green
